label: New Orleans residential
pattern: Rear-door pry entry at single-family homes in Mid-City and Gentilly, 1 to 4 am, white Nissan Xterra seen leaving.

leads.fact: White Nissan Xterra SUV in five of six reports
leads.action: Plate-reader query for white Xterra near the six addresses, 4 to 12 Mar, 1 to 4 am; pull stolen-vehicle reports for white Xterras that week

leads.fact: Doorbell camera at NOLA-109 caught a roof rack and a rear dent on the vehicle
leads.action: Canvass doorbell and business cameras on the approach streets for the same roof rack and dent

leads.fact: All six homes are within 1.8 miles of the Broad Street and Orleans Avenue corridor
leads.action: Focus patrol and a bait-property watch on the corridor between 1 and 4 am

leads.fact: Jewelry, handguns and a laptop taken in four reports
leads.action: Alert pawn shops and the secondary-metals database for jewelry and serial-numbered laptops

leads.fact: Jefferson Parish reported two matching rear-door pry entries the same week
leads.action: Call Jefferson Parish burglary unit to compare vehicle and tool-mark details

missing: No plate recorded in any report
Tool-mark photos exist for only two of six scenes
